svg.title: @hxp-tools Overworld Atlas
svg.desc: Illustrated overworld campaign map for 14 @hxp-tools packages across 8 worlds: W7 Brief (pillars), W1 God (godpowers, godplans, goddesign, godaudits), W2 Proof (mythify), W3 DNA (codedna, docdna), W4 Audit (auditor-suite), W5 Voice (authenticity-check, humanizer, voiceprint), W8 Arc (ready-suite), and side campaign W6 Ink (scriveno).
svg.text: Campaign route from briefing to launch

g.text: Core discipline stack. Hook-enforced gates across every stage.
Plans close only on a real exit 0.
Zero deps · any model · CLI + MCP
Match repo style and write docs the code proves.
Eight read-only domain audits agents act on.
Diagnose, clean, rewrite once. Never invent facts.
Idea to launch in one composable arc
Eleven composable skills from kickoff to release. Artifacts are the contract.
Spec-driven creative writing, publishing, and translation.

svg.text: Campaign: 1 Brief -> 2 God -> 3 Proof -> 4 DNA -> 5 Audit -> 6 Voice -> 7 Launch · Side quest: Ink
